Sam: Kickoff for Acme POC perf runs. Need a final load plan and to confirm billing behavior for spike traffic. @Priya can you own the load matrix? @Liam can you confirm dedicated pool slot Thu 09:00 PST?
Priya: I can. Proposed matrix: steady-state (8k seq, 50 qps for 10m), stress bursts (200 qps for 90s, 3 repeats, 3m spacing), and a soak (30 qps for 60m). Their SLA ask: p99 < 250ms. Any objections to models/config?
Liam: Dedicated slot available Thu 09:00-11:30 PST. rdm-1 tuned build gives best tail numbers; rdm-1-quant reduces memory but ups p50 slightly. Recommend enabling prefix/KV cache for the repeated prompt pattern.
Jenna: FYI Acme's InfoSec requested encryption-at-rest proof, KMS audit sample, and log retention policy before we start full runs. They'll accept a scoped POC attestation, but we need an owner for the questionnaire.
Sam: Ok, we'll need the questionnaire answered before scheduled runs. @Priya own the answers, @Jenna handle audit/logs, @Liam handle network isolation and deployment notes. I'll handle the commercial/contract side and a possible LOI clause.
Priya: Drafting answers now. I'll drop link to the internal doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/partners/acme-poc-sec-qna.md
perf-bot: Job queued: run-id 56010 for 2026-04-02 09:00:00 PST. Attached default profile.
Liam: Small config note: for latency tests use batch_size=8 and max_seq cap to avoid tail OOM. Running locally with:```
rwood run --pool dedicated-acme --model rdm-1 --batch 8 --qps 50 --dur 600
```
Priya: Pricing question from Acme: will burst traffic be billed at committed/reserved rate or on-demand? Sam, can we offer a POC billing concession for bursts?
Sam: Bursts are normally usage-billed at on-demand unless covered by reserve. For POC we can grant a temporary 20% credit on usage for up to $X spend if they sign an LOI within 30 days. I'll confirm limits with finance and post a short note.
Jenna: After preliminary baseline run: p95 ~115ms, p99 ~330ms. We saw tail spikes tied to context fetches and one OOM on worker-3 at minute 7. Recommend enabling KV cache + retry policy and retest.
Priya: Summary from baseline: steady 50 qps looks fine. Burst at 200 qps without cache breached p99 SLO. Root causes: cache misses + occasional >8k sequences. Plan: enable KV cache, cap sequences at 4k for bursts, and try quantized model to reduce mem.
Liam: Spinning rdm-1-quant with kernel flags and KV cache now. Will run optimized test in ~25m. perf-bot will publish artifacts when done.
perf-bot: Run 56011 started. Artifacts: https://redwood.internal/artifacts/56011/summary.json
Sam: Acme asked about support during ramp. For enterprise add-on we can provide 24/7 incident support + 4hr response SLA. Good for POC?
Jenna: That's fine for trial. Also confirm POC log retention: we can commit to 30-day audit log retention for the scope of the trial.
Priya: Deliverables: 1-page technical results (latency histograms + flamegraphs), a single-slide exec summary with recommended commercial path, and short runbook for canary/rollback. Target: Friday EOD.
Liam: Final numbers from run 56011 (quant + KV cache): steady 50 qps => p50 48ms, p95 108ms, p99 225ms. Burst 200 qps => p50 62ms, p95 145ms, p99 255ms. No OOMs, GPU mem stable, CPU/GPU util within expected ranges.
Priya: Noted — burst p99 255ms, slightly above the 250ms target. Options: (1) cap burst to 175-180 qps (predicted p99 ~240ms), or (2) add one more reserved GPU node (cost delta on slide). I'll include both in the results doc.
Sam: I'll draft two commercial proposals: Option A: keep current pool + limit burst to 175 qps with a 20% POC usage credit; Option B: upgrade reserved capacity to hit p99 < 250ms with a quoted price delta. Will send to Acme after QA.
Jenna: I've attached the short canary/rollback checklist and the security attestation we'll use for the POC.
Priya: Finalizing results doc and single-slide summary now; will upload link here when ready.
Sam: Great work. If Acme requests a deeper engineering debrief we'll schedule a follow-up with infra folks.
Liam: Pasting perf summary artifact link: https://redwood.internal/artifacts/56011/final-report.pdf
perf-bot: Run 56011 completed at 2026-04-02T09:45:00-08:00. Logs uploaded.
Priya: Done 1: results doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/pocs/acme-perf-summary-2026-04-02.pdf and exec slide: https://redwood.internal/slides/acme-exec-2026-04-02.pdf
Sam: I'll send the commercial note and include the two paths. Closing thread unless we hear back from Acme with follow-ups.
